verdict.rationale: Puzzle ships its own AI features (Accounting AI, AI Close agents), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. The only MCP evidence describes the opposite role: Puzzle's MCP connects a Puzzle account to Claude so Claude can reach Puzzle data. That server-side capability does not transfer to this client-side story, and nothing shows Puzzle consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
